description:
`Server.handle_continue(:advance_window, ...)` (server.ex:282-290) checks `t.allow_window_advancement` and skips the advance while a compaction is open. `handle_info(:timeout, ...)` (server.ex:394) calls `Logic.advance_window/1` with no such guard.

A window advance during an open compaction evicts versions and moves `index_db.durable_version`. The compaction task captured the pre-advance `durable_version`, and the cutover then looks that version up in the live `versions` list with a strict match (`server.ex:477`) — a MatchError that takes the worker down.

Bounded today: nothing in `lib/` drives `:compact`, so the cutover is only reachable from tests. It becomes live the moment compaction is scheduled (bedrock-947).

One clause, or moving the guard into `Logic.advance_window/1` so both callers share it.

Found by the cold audit on bedrock-3v1 (note N3); pre-existing, not introduced there.

comments.text: Draft PR: https://github.com/bedrock-kv/bedrock/pull/287 — :timeout path now routes through the same allow_window_advancement guard as handle_continue(:advance_window); repro pinned in CompactionCutoverTest, full suite green, cold audit PASS-WITH-NOTES.

title: [BUG] Olivine window advance on the :timeout path ignores allow_window_advancement
